mutations.name: ttft-is-e2e
mutations.old: return RequestResult(outcome, reason, first - t0, end - t0, itl, tokens, source, finish)
mutations.new: return RequestResult(outcome, reason, end - t0, end - t0, itl, tokens, source, finish)

mutations.name: failed-averaged-in
mutations.old: ok = [r for r in results if r.outcome == OK]
mutations.new: ok = [r for r in results if r.ttft_s is not None]

mutations.name: goodput-over-ok-only
mutations.old: "goodput": (sum(meets(r) for r in ok) / len(results)) if results and slo else None,
mutations.new: "goodput": (sum(meets(r) for r in ok) / len(ok)) if ok and slo else None,

mutations.name: http-error-ok
mutations.old: return RequestResult(UNAVAILABLE, f"HTTP {exc.code}: the server refused the request")

mutations.name: no-content-ok
mutations.old: return RequestResult(HARNESS_FAILED, "stream ended with no content token",
mutations.new: return RequestResult(OK, "stream ended with no content token",
